status: First PLA fit/function prototype; no fabrication approval or physical grip qualification.
frame: XY is the clamp cross-section, Z follows the straight filament. Filament axis X=Y=0. Open pose lies flat at Z=0..4.

hinge.model: Constant neutral-axis length, circular in-plane leaf; lower root/tangent fixed. Open pose reduces the closed leaf sweep by 25 degrees. Uniform-curvature strain is a screening estimate, not a root-strain or material allowable.

latch.release: Pull the outside lower tongue outward (+X) until its hook clears the catch, then let the moving jaw open. Push the upper jaw down to close; the smooth catch ramp deflects the tongue outward.

interfaces.scope: Closed clip only: radial envelope about the straight filament axis. Actual fitting projection, cap height and user tail length remain outlet assembly checks.

prototype.process: Factory 0.20 mm Standard; no custom profile required by this source
prototype.orientation: OPEN pose flat, Z=0 on bed; both jaws, curved leaf and latch flex in XY. No support geometry.
prototype.first_test: Inspect that 0.8 mm leaf/jaws/latch are continuous, side-load 1.75 mm PLA filament, close once by hand, test a gentle pull, release and inspect for whitening/cracks/filament marking. A successful first closure does not qualify sustained hold, cycles, TPU or abrasive filament.
prototype.limitations: PLA properties, local root strain, actual extrusion widths, shrinkage, latch snap force, grip force, creep and fatigue unqualified. Nominal 0.15 mm filament interference is not a holding-force prediction.
